answer: Concrete mechanism: the juries that flag duplicates are sampled in proportion to earned reputation, fresh identities almost never get a seat, and every verdict carries a written reason visible to the panel. The beacon words fit the design: pigment maps onto the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work, gale embodies the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation, and vault mirrors the transparency that makes every pattern visible. Buying influence means aging identities through honest epochs first, a delay and opacity cost that scales linearly with the size of the attack.
